fixer.summary: T-50 is fixed. In `cast()`, the Total Cover refusal now cites `rule="SPELL.casting-spells.effects.targets#2"` and keeps `page=106`. The check above it carries the tag `# SRD[SPELL.casting-spells.effects.targets#2]` (`dungdra/spells.py:138-144`). I added a unit test that casts fire bolt at a goblin behind Total Cover and checks the refusal's rule and page. The ticket names no acceptance tests, so there was nothing to run with `--runxfail`. Unit tests pass (360). The SRD tests in `tests/srd/test_spells.py` and `tests/srd/test_playing_the_game.py` pass (102 passed, 2 xfailed). `ruff check`, `ruff format --check` and `dev-gate` are clean.

review.summary: The fix does what the ticket asks. The Total Cover refusal in cast() now cites rule="SPELL.casting-spells.effects.targets#2", and its comment has the SRD[...#2] tag. That matches stage A's clause #2, the clear-path / Total Cover clause. Nothing else in the engine logic changed. The new unit test casts at a target behind real Total Cover and checks the rule and page cited on the refusal. That is the behaviour this ticket changes, and the test uses no mocks. The loop/costs.jsonl line is the loop's own bookkeeping. No other place in the engine still cites the bare rule id: _invalid_target already adds #10 and #11.
